More than a thousand years ago, before the year 2100,
they created the great inland sea.

To fill the vastness of these new lands,
They brought back creatures from a distant age…

And when the world outside went silent,
Their age of wonder and hubris came to an end.

The vast cities crumbled.
And over hundreds of years three nations formed,
Fighting terrible wars with spear and shield.

Until finally, the great inland sea began to dry.
And the world once again was unmade.

Now only a few of us remain.

A new age has dawned…
